title: A helper with two lines
prompt: The robot's status report is two lines. Write `report`, which prints "Health OK" and then "Level 1", and call it from `solve`.
hints: A function body can be as many lines as you need, all indented the same amount.
`func report():` followed by two print lines, then `report()` in solve.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
